articles.summary: CNW Group: NEO Battery Achieves Official Vendor Status with Asian Fortune Global 500 Automotive OEM. NEO Battery Materials Ltd. ("NEO" or the "Company") (TSXV: NBM) (OTC: NBMFF), a low-cost, silicon-enhanced battery developer that enables longer-running, rapid-charging batteries for drones, robotics, and electronics, is pleased to announce that it has received official vendor status approval from an Asian Fortune Global 500 automotive original equipment manufacturer (OEM) (the "Customer"). articles.summary: PR Newswire: David MacNaughton joins CIBC as a Strategic Advisor. CIBC announced today that David MacNaughton has joined the bank as a Strategic Advisor.
